review_candidates.title: Business Analyst / Business Systems Analyst / Business Process Analyst
review_candidates.description: Role Description The Business Analyst / Business Systems Analyst / Business Process Analyst is a full-time remote role responsible for analyzing and improving business processes, systems, and requirements to support Education in Africa’s mission. Day-to-day tasks include gathering and documenting business requirements from stakeholders, mapping current and future-state processes, and identifying opportunities for operational and system improvements. The role involves performing systems analysis to assess how existing tools and platforms can better support educational programs, as well as collaborating with product, technology, and operations teams to design and implement solutions. The analyst will create clear documentation such as process flows, functional specifications, and user stories, and support testing, validation, and continuous improvement of systems. This position requires regular communication with internal and external stakeholders, using data and insights to recommend changes that increase efficiency, transparency, and impact. Qualifications Strong Business Analysis and Business Requirements skills, with experience in eliciting, documenting, and managing requirements across multiple stakeholders. Proficiency in Business Systems Analysis and Systems Analysis, including understanding how business needs translate into system capabilities and configurations. Demonstrated Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and develop evidence-based recommendations. Experience creating process maps, workflows, and use cases, and working with tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or similar. Solid understanding of project lifecycle and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or hybrid approaches), with ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams. Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present findings clearly and facilitate discussions in a remote environment. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and maintain attention to detail in a distributed team setting. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; experience in education, non-profit, or international development sectors is an advantage.

RIS is composed of Pre-Award Services; Strategic Services, including Major Research Projects (MRP), Strategic Initiatives (SI) and the Core Research Equipment & Instrument Training (CREAIT) Network; Hibernia and Hebron Research & Development Initiative (HHRDI); the Centre for Analytics, Informatics and Research (CAIR); and the Clean Arctic Shipping Initiative (CASI). DUTIES Responsibilities Reporting to the Director, the Associate Director, Pre-Award oversees and manages all aspects of the pre-award services division within RIS and carries out the operational objectives of this division. Responsibilities include ensuring the efficient and effective pre-award administration and recording of all research funded and carried out at Memorial University. As a member of the senior management group within RIS, the position formulates strategic initiatives to enhance service delivery, improve efficiency, and maintain compliance with requirements imposed by provincial, federal, and international funding agencies, including research involving human subjects, use of animals, use of biohazardous materials, and research involving Indigenous groups. The position holds delegated institutional signing authority from the Director for a wide range of research-related documents and will be designated as Acting Director for RIS during periods when the Director is on leave. Duties include: Overseeing institutional review, approval, and formal submission of applications to funding agencies. Overseeing the review and negotiation of terms and conditions in research contracts and agreements. Institutional sign-off on research applications, contracts, and agreements. Overseeing the capture of pre-award information on Memorial's research effort. Ensuring office records are maintained according to the MUN retention schedule, as RIS holds the institutional records for research applications and agreements. Authorizing the opening of research accounts by Financial and Administrative Services after verification of all necessary clearances or permits. Overseeing the administration of Memorial's internal grant competitions. Ensuring that all pre-award accountability and regulatory requirements of the Tri-Council (CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC) and other federal, provincial, and local funding agencies and sponsors are met. Maintaining communication and positive working relationships with all sponsors, including government, industry, and community organizations. Managing research applications and contracts within the framework of research security. Overseeing the provision of accurate and timely information about research funding opportunities through a funding opportunities database. Participation on various institutional committees, and oversight of annual and special projects, as necessary. Qualifications Substantial experience (5-8 years) in a research administration environment; a graduate level degree, and a proven track record across progressively responsible roles are required; or an equivalent combination of experience and training may be considered. The ideal candidate will have sound leadership, management, and problem-solving ability, as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills. The ability to work under tight deadlines and manage with professionalism under stressful circumstances is essential. Experience working with industry, government, or funding agencies is considered an asset. SALARY $96,244 - $126,638 per annum (Leadership Group) CLOSING DATE September 24, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. NST All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply; however, p reference will be given to applicants who are legally entitled to work in Canada. Memorial is committed to providing an inclusive learning and work environment. If there is anything we can do to ensure your full participation during the application process, please contact equity@mun.ca directly and we will work with you to make appropriate arrangements. The personal information requested in your application is collected under the authority of the Memorial University Act (RSNL 1990 c M-7) for the purpose of identifying and recruiting candidates; assessing applicant qualifications; and maintaining records pertaining to the administration of employment with Memorial University of Newfoundland. If you are a successful candidate, this information will form part of your permanent employment record and will be used for other activities related to the employment process. This information may be disclosed to government departments and agencies as legally required; and to third party service providers, as necessary to administer programs and activities. If you have any questions about the collection, use and disclosure of the information on this form, please contact MyHR, Department of Human Resources, at recruitment@mun.ca. Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills across all levels of the organization. Strong communication and presentation skills in both Arabic and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Learning Management System (LMS) platforms. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under pressure. High level of confidentiality, professionalism, and attention to detail.

review_candidates.description: About Metachrome Metachrome International S.A.L. is a leading distributor and supplier of plumbing, sanitary, heating, and related products in Lebanon. We represent a portfolio of international brands and serve a wide network of plumbing professionals, contractors, retailers, wholesalers, and specialized showrooms. We are looking for a motivated Sales Representative to join our growing sales team and develop strong, long-term relationships with customers across the Lebanese market. Position Overview The Sales Representative will be responsible for developing sales within an assigned customer base and territory, introducing customers to Metachrome’s product portfolio, identifying new business opportunities, and achieving defined sales targets. This position follows a Progressive Product Track , meaning the representative will progressively develop expertise across different product categories and brands. As product knowledge, sales performance, and customer relationships grow, the representative will take on greater responsibility and more advanced product lines. Key Responsibilities Visit existing and prospective customers regularly to develop and maintain strong business relationships. Generate sales by understanding customer needs and recommending appropriate products. Introduce and promote Metachrome’s brands and product ranges to plumbers, plumbing shops, hardware stores, bathroom showrooms, contractors, and other relevant customers. Develop new accounts and identify opportunities to expand sales with existing customers. Present product features, applications, benefits, and competitive advantages clearly and professionally. Follow up on quotations, orders, customer requests, and outstanding opportunities. Monitor market activity, competitor products, pricing, and customer feedback. Work closely with the sales and management teams to achieve monthly and annual sales objectives. Maintain accurate records of customer visits, opportunities, quotations, and sales activities. Provide regular feedback to management regarding market conditions, customer needs, and potential new products. Ensure proper follow-up after sales to strengthen customer loyalty and encourage repeat business. Continuously develop product knowledge and progress toward managing more advanced and strategic product categories. Progressive Product Track The successful candidate will gradually progress through Metachrome’s product portfolio based on performance, product knowledge, and demonstrated ability. Level 1 – Core Products Learn and sell established, high-volume product categories while developing fundamental sales and customer-management skills. Level 2 – Expanded Product Portfolio Take responsibility for additional product categories, develop deeper technical knowledge, and increase the value of sales generated per customer. Level 3 – Advanced / Strategic Products Manage higher-value and more specialized product lines, develop key customer relationships, and become a product specialist within assigned categories. Level 4 – Senior Sales Responsibility High-performing representatives may progress toward larger accounts, key customers, territory responsibility, product management, or sales leadership opportunities. Requirements Previous experience in sales, preferably in plumbing, sanitary, construction, hardware, HVAC, or a related industry. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships. Results-oriented and motivated by achieving sales targets. Good organizational and follow-up skills. Ability to work independently and manage a schedule of customer visits. Willingness to learn technical product information and develop strong product knowledge. Valid driver’s license and ability to travel for customer visits. Fluency in Arabic; good English communication skills are an advantage. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is: Ambitious and motivated to grow within the company. Proactive in finding new customers and sales opportunities. Reliable in following up with customers and commitments. Commercially minded , with an understanding of how to turn customer needs into sales. Eager to learn , particularly about technical products and their applications. Relationship-oriented , understanding that successful sales are built over time. Accountable for results , with a strong focus on achieving measurable objectives. Compensation & Growth Metachrome offers a competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives and a clear opportunity for professional growth. The Progressive Product Track is designed to reward representatives who demonstrate strong sales performance, product knowledge, customer development, and leadership potential.

review_candidates.description: September 2, 2026 INSTRUCTOR Offshore Safety & Survival Centre Marine Institute (Two-Year contractual position) The Offshore Safety & Survival Centre (OSSC) invites applications for the position of Instructor for a five-year contractual appointment located in Foxtrap, NL. Reporting to the Director, Offshore Safety & Survival Centre, the successful candidate will be responsible for the delivery of both theoretical and practical instruction in marine, offshore, and industrial emergency response training programs. Training will be delivered primarily at the OSSC Foxtrap Campus and the Marine Base in Holyrood. Occasional assignments may be required at other locations within Newfoundland and Labrador, and in northern regions including the Northwest Territories and Nunavut. DUTIES Responsibilities In accordance with the OSSC’s risk management protocols and applicable governing standards, regulations, and guidelines, the primary responsibilities of the position will include, but are not limited to: Supervise and ensure participant safety and compliance with established risk management procedures during all training activities. Deliver classroom instruction in firefighting, marine survival, and rescue craft operations. Conduct and supervise live-fire exercises, open-water survival training, and rescue operations in both controlled and natural environments. Lead in the development, review, and revision of training courses to ensure alignment with current standards and best practices. Perform administrative duties related to course delivery, documentation, and reporting, as directed by the OSSC Director. Supporting other instructional and operational duties as assigned. The duties outlined above are not intended to be exhaustive and the successful candidate will be familiarized on the roles and responsibilities including reviewing of a comprehensive job description during the hiring process. Qualifications The successful applicants must have at least four (4) years relevant experience in a marine or offshore environment, relevant three (3) year diploma or approved equivalent, possess a valid Transport Canada Marine medical or approved equivalent; and demonstrated ability to work in and around an aquatic environment. The successful applicant shall hold a valid Transport Canada Certificate of Competency to a minimum of Watchkeeping Mate or Second Class Engineer. Preference will be given to candidates with advanced education, relevant Transport Canada certificates of competencies, previous teaching experience, experience in offshore/marine helicopter operations, experience in Major Emergency Management and/or additional related qualifications. Equivalent qualifications or experience with the Department of National Defence, an emergency organization or a safety and survival training organization may be considered.
